definitions.explanation: The reproductive unit of a plant, containing the embryo and stored nutrients. A more formal or scientific term compared to the everyday word {種|たね}.

examples.japanese: この{植物|しょくぶつ}は{種子|しゅし}で{増|ふ}える。
{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧種|きぐしゅ}の{種子|しゅし}を{保存|ほぞん}するための{施設|しせつ}がある。
examples.english: There are facilities for preserving the seeds of endangered species.

notes:
USAGE:
{種子|しゅし} is the formal or scientific term for seeds. In everyday conversation, {種|たね} is more common. {種子|しゅし} appears frequently in botany, agriculture, and environmental contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種子|しゅし}{植物|しょくぶつ} (seed plant)
- {種子|しゅし}を{保存|ほぞん}する (to preserve seeds)
- {種子|しゅし}{島|しま} (Tanegashima — note: different reading たねがしま)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {種|たね}: seed — the everyday word, also means cause or material
- {実|み}: fruit, nut — the mature seed-bearing part of a plant
